## Grounding

Real market-standard discipline: opportunity discovery and
go-to-market strategy at the group/ecosystem-holding level. **Worked
example** cited by reference, never re-derived: legacy formation
`GRP-01` ("Ecosystem Entrepreneurship," `backend/seed_data.py:979-990`,
28h, badge "Ecosystem Entrepreneur"), specifically module
`GRP-01-M02` ("Détecter une opportunité d'entité CVLN," `backend/
seed_modules.py`) — deliverable "3 opportunités d'entité présentées."
Per the corpus's own code-collision discipline, this row's internal
document code is `GRP-EXT-01`, never bare `GRP-01`, to avoid any
silent collision with the legacy runtime formation. Legacy `GRP-01`
stays exactly as delivered, untouched, cited only.

## Objectives

1. Apply an opportunity-discovery framework at professional
   specialization depth, citing `GRP-01-M02`'s real deliverable
   format (a structured presentation of 3 candidate opportunities) as
   the worked example, never re-deriving its content from scratch.
2. Distinguish this formation's professional-depth go-to-market
   specialization from legacy `GRP-01`'s broader survey-level
   coverage of the same theme (opportunity detection is one of 7
   modules in a broader 28h formation) — a deepening, never a
   duplication.
3. Never conflate this row's document code (`GRP-EXT-01`) with the
   legacy runtime formation code `GRP-01` — a real code-collision risk
   this corpus explicitly guards against.
